title: Creation from Nothing
description: Before inflation, before time: a closed universe can tunnel into existence from no space at all, or begin without a boundary, its time becoming space near the start like the South Pole of a sphere. Quantum cosmology writes the wave function of the whole universe. Unlocks the No-Boundary Seed.

puzzle.goal: Quantise a closed universe with only one degree of freedom, its radius a, filled with vacuum energy Λ. The Hamiltonian constraint becomes a Schrödinger-like equation with zero energy for the wave function ψ(a) of the whole universe: a kinetic term from the curvature of ψ, minus a potential a² − (Λ/3)a⁴ that forms a barrier between a = 0 and the classical universe (units with the factor 3π/2G absorbed). Write it.
puzzle.name: Wheeler–DeWitt equation (closed minisuperspace; tunnelling from nothing)
puzzle.ask: Tunnelling through the barrier from a = 0 (from nothing) has probability P ∝ exp(−3/(8G²ρ_V)). With G = 1 and the vacuum energy density ρ in Planck units, find the exponent 3/(8G²ρ).
puzzle.method: Write the Einstein-Hilbert action for a closed FRW universe, keep only a, form the Hamiltonian and replace the momentum by −iħ d/da. The WKB integral under the barrier gives the exponent.
